name: com.gexiro/dach-pulse-mcp
title: Gexiro DACH Pulse & Alexa Voice Suite MCP
description: Keyless DACH & home MCP (18 tools): DB rail, EPEX power, NINA/DWD alerts, fuel, airfryer & FX.

tools.name: get_epex_electricity_price
tools.description: Get live and upcoming hourly EPEX Spot Day-Ahead electricity prices in Germany (ct/kWh wholesale spot and retail gross) and cheapest EV/appliance window.

tools.name: get_heating_oil_and_pellet_price
tools.description: Get live German/Austrian heating oil (Heizöl EL per 100L) and ENplus A1 wood pellet prices (€/t) with Brent Crude 7-day buy/wait recommendation.

tools.name: get_dewpoint_ventilation_advice
tools.description: Calculate outdoor vs indoor/basement absolute humidity (g/m³) and dew point (°C) using Magnus-Tetens physics for mold-free ventilation and heat pump COP timing.

city.description: City name (e.g. Frankfurt, München, Berlin, London, New York)

tools.name: get_emergency_notdienst_info
tools.description: Retrieve official 24/7 German Poison Control (Giftnotruf), US Poison Control (1-800-222-1222), UK NHS 111, medical on-call (116 117), and emergency pharmacies.

city_or_state.description: City or state (e.g. Köln, Bayern, Berlin, London, New York)

tools.name: get_train_departures_db
tools.description: Query live Deutsche Bahn (DB IRIS-TTS) train departures, ICE/IC/RE lines, platforms, and real-time delay minutes for any German train station.

station.description: German railway station name (e.g. Berlin Hbf, München Hbf, Köln Hbf, Frankfurt Hbf)

tools.name: get_fuel_station_prices_de
tools.description: Get current German fuel prices (Super E10, Super E5, Diesel, HVO100, Autogas LPG, AdBlue) and Bundeskartellamt MTS-K intraday cheapest refuel window.

city.description: German city (e.g. Berlin, München, Köln, Hamburg)

fuel_type.description: Fuel type: Super E10, Super E5, Diesel, HVO100, Autogas LPG, or AdBlue

tools.name: get_autobahn_traffic_status
tools.description: Fetch live traffic jams, roadworks, and closures on any German federal motorway (A1–A99) from Die Autobahn GmbH des Bundes.

autobahn.description: Autobahn identifier (e.g. A1, A2, A3, A7, A8, A9)

tools.name: get_weather_and_civil_warnings
tools.description: Fetch official German BBK NINA / DWD civil protection and severe weather alerts plus live wind gusts (km/h) and precipitation.

region.description: German state or city (e.g. Nordrhein-Westfalen, Bayern, Hamburg)

tools.name: get_river_gauge_level
tools.description: Get live river water levels (cm), 24h delta, and flood/navigation trend from WSV Pegelonline (Rhine, Elbe, Danube, Main, Moselle, Weser).

station.description: Station or city (e.g. Köln, Düsseldorf, Kaub, Dresden, Passau, Frankfurt)

tools.name: get_airfryer_cooking_program
tools.description: Look up exact air fryer temperature (°C and °F), cooking duration (minutes), and crispness tips across 186 foods, or convert oven recipes.

food_item.description: Food item in German or English (e.g. Pommes, Lachs, Kuchen, Brötchen, salmon, chicken wings)

tools.name: get_currency_and_crypto_rate
tools.description: Fetch live European Central Bank (ECB) foreign exchange rates (USD, CHF, GBP, PLN, JPY, TRY) and real-time Bitcoin/Ethereum/Solana spot prices.

asset.description: Currency or crypto ticker (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, USD, CHF, GBP, PLN)

tools.name: get_pollen_allergy_index
tools.description: Retrieve official Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) 8-allergen pollen load (birch, grass, hazel, alder, ragweed, mugwort, rye, ash) and PM2.5/Ozone air quality.

tools.name: get_school_holidays_and_bridge_days
tools.description: Get upcoming German school vacations (Schulferien) and statutory public holidays (Feiertage) with countdown in days.

tools.name: get_shift_work_calendar
tools.description: Calculate ISO-8601 calendar week (Kalenderwoche KW) and rotating shift schedule (3-Schicht, 4-Schicht, 2-Schicht, 24h Feuerwehr) for any target date.

tools.name: get_tv_primetime_lineup
tools.description: Get live German television broadcasts running right now and tonight at 20:15 CET primetime (Das Erste, ZDF, RTL, ProSieben, SAT.1, VOX, ARTE, 3sat).

channel.description: Optional TV channel name (e.g. Das Erste, ZDF, RTL, ProSieben)

tools.name: get_german_license_plate_info
tools.description: Decode 700+ German vehicle license plate prefixes (Kfz-Kennzeichen & Altkennzeichen like CLZ, WAN, M, B) and telephone area codes (Vorwahlen).

plate_or_city.description: License plate code (e.g. CLZ, HH, M), city name, or area code (e.g. 030, 089)

tools.name: get_waste_collection_schedule
tools.description: Get upcoming municipal 4-stream household waste collection dates (Restmüll, Biomüll, Altpapier, Gelber Sack / Wertstoff).

waste_type.description: Optional stream filter: Restmüll, Biomüll, Papier, or Gelber Sack

tools.name: get_daily_flash_briefing
tools.description: Generate the full Gexiro Daily Germany & Smart Home Briefing (EPEX electricity spot price, cheapest appliance window, Rhine river gauge, and ISO week).

locale.description: Locale code: de-DE, en-US, or en-GB (default de-DE)
